preconditions.description: Attacker must be the contract owner to exploit compiler-specific vulnerabilities

exploit_hint: The contract uses Solidity 0.6.12 which has known vulnerabilities including missing overflow checks in certain operations. As owner, exploit compiler-specific issues to manipulate contract state, potentially through integer overflow/underflow in reflection calculations or fee mechanisms. Use owner privileges to call functions like setTaxFeePercent, setLiquidityFeePercent, or setMaxTxPercent with extreme values that may trigger unexpected behavior due to compiler bugs.
